name: Valinda Lombard
quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left and could say, 'I used everything You gave me'.
bio: Art can be an escape, an idealisation, or simply a means of play - (Author Unknown)

I have enjoyed drawing and colouring ever since I can remember and am very fortunate to pursue my dreams of becoming a full time artist. Being able to do what I actually believe in; putting pencil to paper, or brush to canvas anytime I want, is living the best life. I have been painting since the early 1980's.

Art can be a challenge; both frustrating and rewarding at the same time, leading to a sense of accomplishment, or a determination to do (practice) more and that is why I believe that it is important to endlessly be able to learn and grow as an artist.

My drawing and painting style has always been very detailed. I attempt a looser style every now and again, but prefer photo-realism. Being able to move people intellectually or emotionally through the art i have created is a wonderful and fulfilling feeling.

The pride and sense of accomplishment after I've finished a great sketch or painting is exhilarating. Art is exciting, empowering and an expression of love. For me, it is not just about putting pencil to paper, or brush to canvas, it is a way of seeing the world, a way of expression, oftentimes a compulsion. I simply must create and explore my world and my imagination.

name: Jacqueline Bekker
quote: Making art stirs something deep within our souls, awakening emotions, sparking curiosity, and allowing us to connect with a vision and profound stories that lie beyond the canvas.
bio: Jacqueline was born in South Africa and moved to Zimbabwe at the age of 3 where she spent most of her life.

From 1985 until 1990 she studied painting at the Peter Birch School of Art. From 1990 until 1995 she painted wildlife, and from 1995 until 2001 she attended the University of South Africa during which time she moved to England where she completed a BA (Hons) in Fine Art at Northbrook College in Worthing. During this time, she attended Stout University in Wisconsin, America as an exchange student.

Jacqueline has exhibited work internationally at The Swiss Art Fair, the Florence Biennale, the Da Vinci in Italy, and an Art Expo at the Louvre in Paris, France, as well as many smaller exhibitions in Europe.
Jacqueline's subject when studying was ‘Process and the Alchemy of Art' in which she experimented with many different processes, techniques, substances, and styles.

name: Rourke Lyte-Mason
quote: Besides God, artists are the only ones who can literally move mountains.
bio: I am Rourke Lyte-Mason. I joined Art Alive Art School when I was 16 years old.

In 2013, I took a gap year and attended Art Alive Art School where I realized I wanted to be an artist. I started studying Fine Art at the University of Johannesburg in 2014 and in 2015 I won the Thami Mnyele Painting Merit Award.
In 2017 & 2018, I made the top 100 in both the Thami Mnyele & Sasol New Signatures. I represented the University of Johannesburg at the Association of Arts Pretoria Student Events in 2017 and 2018.

I graduated with my National Diploma and my BA Degree for Fine Art at the University of Johannesburg in 2017 and 2018 and became an art teacher at Benhale Academy Christian Private School and worked there till 2020 and joined Springs Boys' High School in 2021.
I try to always paint as realistically as possible to help shape and form a reality of my art buyer's and my own story/background.

name: Sónette van der Merwe
quote: If you truly love nature, you will find beauty everywhere.
bio: I'm an artist based in the East rand, where I bring my own brand of creativity to life. I don't box myself in with a specific style — I explore, experiment, and go wherever the art takes me. My work is a reflection of what moves me in the moment: the wild beauty of animals, the pulse of city life, and the raw, unapologetic energy that fuels everything.

As an art instructor, I'm passionate about guiding others to find their voice, too. I believe that art isn't about following trends; it's about tapping into your true self and creating without limits. Whether I'm working on my own pieces or helping others unlock their creativity, it's all about honest expression and the power of making something that matters.
I am fluent across all mediums, but I tend to drift back to oils, charcoals and watercolors the most, as they tend to feel more natural to my style.
Art to me isn't a hobby — it's a way of life. I don't just make art; I live it.

name: Monnette van de Venter
quote: Art enables us to find ourselves and lose ourselves at the same time.
bio: Hi there! My name is Monnette van de Venter.
I am a young artist and have been painting since I was a little girl.
I started at Art Alive Art School as a student when I was 8 years old.
I am now the proud teacher of a wonderful group of talented little artists at the studio.
I found a passion for painting flowers a few years ago and have never looked back.

name: Karen Bond
quote: The purpose of art is washing the dust of daily life off our souls.
bio: Growing up, I always wanted to create or make something and was strongly attracted to art. Having painted for over 22 years, I learned many skills from various teachers and full-time artists. I tended mostly towards the medium of oils because of its forgiving and manipulating qualities but continue to learn other mediums.

Art is a continuously evolving and stimulating practice to express the quintessence of the grand adventure called life. It will teach you pleasure, pain and patience all at the same time. The practice of creating art is also a form of mindfulness, giving attention to the here and now. It's like therapy, and you get art.
I love how different individuals are, and each bring their own unique style and ideas. Art is a wonderful expression that reflects this uniqueness.

name: Bonnie Franks
quote: I don't like to say I have given my life to art. I prefer to say art has given me my life.
bio: I started painting in the 80's after trying many different art forms.
I developed a love of portraiture and have done many commissions.

I joined Art Alive in 2010, and became a teacher in 2012 and have spent many many wonderful hours teaching and helping others achieve their goals. It is my greatest joy to see a student sell their first artwork.
My preferred mediums are oil paints and soft pastels. I paint many different subject matters but have maintained my love of portraiture, be it human or animal.

name: Alice Zotti
quote: Creativity is who I am, it expresses the colours within my light.
bio: Born in Italy but have been living in South Africa most of my life. My faith is precious to me and comes first.

My passion and interests stem further than the fine arts and includes creating art work using all types of mediums on different forms of materials. This enables me to experiment and experience something new.
I have been at the studio since 2016 and it is a privilege to be a teacher at Art Alive Art School.

name: Gini Harris
bio: Gini Harris has a background in graphic design and technical illustrating.
She has taken part in many exhibitions, both nationally and internationally. In 2021, she received the MAA award, making her a member of the Miniature Art Society of America.
She is well known for her commissioned landscapes and portraits.
Although proficient in many mediums and canvas sizes, she has had great success with miniature art in oils.
Gini has worked as a full-time artist for over 35 years and only recently has she taken up the challenge of teaching.

name: Karen T Vermeulen
bio: Karen T Vermeulen is a fully qualified sculptor with more than 30 years of experience working primarily with clay. Her work reveals a deep understanding of form, structure, anatomy and movement, bringing clay to life through confident gesture and refined detail. Karen values traditional hand building techniques and also enjoys exploring contemporary approaches, giving her sculptures a sense of both history and freshness.

Over the past three decades she has developed an exceptional eye for proportion and expression, allowing her to guide beginners and advanced students with clarity and patience. We are delighted to have Karen teaching sculpture with us, where students will benefit from her technical skill, professional expertise and inspiring creative energy.
